### What would you put on autopilot with MausBot?

Running a business comes with a lot of work you have to do again tomorrow. Checking your inbox, following up, pulling together updates, keeping track of what needs attention.

That s the work we re building MausBot for.

Give your bots a job, connect the apps they need, and set routines for recurring tasks. A morning brief before you start work. Draft replies ready for review. A weekly summary you don t have to pull together yourself.

We re launching tomorrow, October 13. MausBot is free and open source, and works with your supported AI account or API key.

Subscribe [...] We open-sourced MausBot about two hours after Grokbot officially launched. We were already building something similar, and seeing the launch gave us the push to share our work, make it open source, and keep building with the community.  
  
The idea behind MausBot is simple: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app. Give each bot a job, choose its model, and keep its conversations and work together.  
  
With MausBot, you can:  
  
- Run bots in parallel for research, writing, and coding.  
- Use Claude, Codex, and other supported engines in one app.  
- Connect tools like GitHub, Gmail, and Slack.  
- Let bots work on your Mac or a connected cloud desktop, with permissions and approval settings you control.
